class.name: VRAMBudgetRegulator
class.brief_description: Auto-regulator that keeps module GPU memory within a VRAM budget.
class.description: Monitors streaming VRAM usage against a device budget and degrades gracefully. As the budget is approached it caps the number of resident chunks and signals eviction; separately, when it detects load/evict thrashing it raises the level-of-detail distance multiplier to shed work, so rendering stays stable on memory-constrained GPUs.

method.name: can_load_more_chunks
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if admitting more resident chunks would stay within the VRAM budget.

method.name: get_current_max_chunks
method.description: Returns the current cap on resident chunks derived from the budget state.

method.name: get_debug_stats_dictionary
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] of current VRAM-usage and regulation statistics for diagnostics.

method.name: get_lod_distance_multiplier
method.description: Returns the level-of-detail distance multiplier the regulator is currently applying; values above 1.0 pull LOD transitions closer to shed memory.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the regulator with the current device VRAM budget and configuration.

method.name: is_budget_warning_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while usage is in the warning band below the hard budget.

method.name: reload_config
method.description: Re-reads the regulator's project-settings configuration (budget fractions, thresholds).

method.name: should_trigger_eviction
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when usage has crossed the eviction threshold and resident chunks should be evicted.
